Notifications You must be signed in to change notification settings Fork 2.3k Star 11.4k Jsoup.parse seems to remove system identifier in DOCTYPE #408 New issue Copy link New issue Copy link Closed Closed Jsoup.parse seems to remove system identifier in DOCTYPE #408 Copy link Description gzli92 opened on Apr 2, 2014 Issue body actions Specifically when I call: Document doc = Jsoup.parse(xhtml, "", Parser.xmlParser()); on a xhtml document that has the following doctype: <!DOCTYPE html SYSTEM "exampledtdfile.dtd"> I end up with the following result in the document (SYSTEM is now missing): <!DOCTYPE html "exampledtdfile.dtd"> But this works fine on a document with: <!DOCTYPE html PUBLIC "-//W3C//DTD XHTML 1.0 Transitional//EN" "http://www.w3.org/TR/xhtml1/DTD/xhtml1-transitional.dtd"> Since SYSTEM is a proper way of declaring a DTD, I believe this is an issue with Jsoup.
